## Result

Describe the user-visible result and link the issue. Use `Closes #…` only when
this PR completes that issue's acceptance criteria. Record status updates by
adding a new `docs/status/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` file; do not edit another PR's
entry or insert dated sections into `docs/status.md`.

## Evidence

- Relevant source checks and exact-head container CI:
- Independent review and resolved findings:
- UI changes: rendered journeys, narrow/double-text, keyboard and accessibility evidence:
- Compatibility: schema, policy, configuration and release-note impact:

Mark inapplicable checks with a reason. Do not substitute an earlier revision's
results for this head.

## Operational scope

Name any target activation, library write or service-retirement follow-up issue
and its concrete approval. Merging implementation or publishing a package does
not approve that operation. Follow `docs/releases.md` for release gates.
